readyNote: Blank run from the spoken framework, Hatchery board, and Content folder map. ASCTeuthisan is bound to Lesser Horde because that card was selected in the supplied vault shot. Shared systems are parented to mode-solo as the authored baseline; online-only and story-only nodes sit on their own mode homes. Folder Zombie_01, Ultimate_Gore_V1, and other undeclared fig-2 bins are filed under Other assets. ARMOURY is both the human rifle pool and the bite-assembled special gun. System layout respaced v1.2 (group columns, 300×156 inner grid).

data.title: Incubation Vault board
data.summaryZh: Hatchery Command Interface：已存协议、筛选、档案、五格编制。
data.summaryEn: Hatchery Command Interface: stored protocols, kind filters, dossier, five field slots.

data.title: Hatchery upgrade board
data.summaryZh: 技能升级界面。资源：HexTree。
data.summaryEn: Skill-upgrade surface for Hatchery tier work. Asset: HexTree.

data.title: Global menu shell
data.summaryZh: 全局菜单 UI。资源：UltimateMenu。
data.summaryEn: Front-end menu chrome. Asset: UltimateMenu.

data.title: VHS bodycam overlay
data.summaryZh: 玩家视角 VHS 界面。资源：UltraCustomizableBodycamComponent。
data.summaryEn: First-person VHS view. Asset: UltraCustomizableBodycamComponent.

data.title: Combat HUD effects
data.summaryZh: 科幻 HUD 特效层。资源：SciFi_HUD_Effects。
data.summaryEn: Sci-fi HUD effect layer. Asset: SciFi_HUD_Effects.

data.title: Protocol dossier copy
data.summaryZh: 冷却、次数、条件、人口消耗、产出、升级句。种类：Player Swarm / Player Skill / Nature Swarm。
data.summaryEn: Cooldown, uses, condition, levy, yield, and upgrade lines. Kinds: Player Swarm, Player Skill, Nature Swarm.

data.title: Reserve versus printed cap
data.summaryZh: 突袭人数受孵化所现存头数限制，不受技能印刷最大值限制。237 库存则最多放出 237。死亡后下次出征从零计。
data.summaryEn: A raid is capped by hatchery headcount, not the skill's printed maximum. Stock 237 yields 237. If they die, the next extract opens at zero.

data.title: Five-slot packing rule
data.summaryZh: 每次出征最多五格。格内为尸潮株或个人瘟疫技能。未入格的已解锁科技不出战。更大的老家不能赢，五格才能赢。
data.summaryEn: Each extract carries at most five slots: horde strain or personal plague skill. Unslotted science cannot fight this raid. The larger home is not the winner; the five slots are.

data.title: Hatchery tier table
data.summaryZh: 耐久 / 攻击 / 移速：1.1× / 1.5× / 2.0× / 2.5× / 3.0×。跳跃：I 跳、II 翻墙、III–V 爬墙。自爆株步态随等级从步行升到疾跑高跳。
data.summaryEn: Fortitude, ferocity, celerity: 1.1× / 1.5× / 2.0× / 2.5× / 3.0×. Leap: I leap, II vault, III–V climb. Bombardier gait walks, then runs, sprints, and high-leaps.

data.title: Lesser Horde sheet
data.summaryZh: 主动玩家尸潮。CD 30s，消耗 50，产出 50 标准僵尸，须占用出战格。数量固定 50。指定网格：ASCTeuthisan。
data.summaryEn: Active player swarm. 30s CD, levy 50, yield 50 standard zombies, field slot required. Volume fixed at 50. Designated mesh folder: ASCTeuthisan.

data.title: Median and Greater Horde sheets
data.summaryZh: 中潮 125 / 大潮 300。均为主动、无限次、30s CD，须入五格。数量固定，不受等级放大。
data.summaryEn: Median 125 / Greater 300. Active, unlimited, 30s CD, must occupy a field slot. Volumes stay fixed across Hatchery tiers.

data.title: Bombardier / Xenomorph / Bulwark sheets
data.titleZh: 自爆 / 异形种 / 肉盾表
data.summaryZh: 自爆 10 只耗 20；异形种 3 只耗 30，优先机甲炮塔；肉盾 20 只耗 45，无伤害、供攀爬翻墙。
data.summaryEn: Bombardier: 10 bombers, levy 20. Xenomorph: 3 lean strains, levy 30, prioritize mechs and turrets. Bulwark: 20 meat-shields, levy 45, no damage, living ramp.

data.title: Passive doctrine sheet
data.summaryZh: 尸潮跳跃、血量、攻击、移速。编入后常驻，无冷却无消耗，必须占格。
data.summaryEn: Swarm Leap, Fortitude, Ferocity, Celerity. Permanent while equipped, no CD, no levy, must occupy a field slot.

data.title: Feral Tide observation entry
data.summaryZh: Observed / Nature Swarm。不可编入、不支取储备。单机道路上的无主灾变；联机此层撤走。
data.summaryEn: Observed Nature Swarm. Not selectable, not levied from the Hatchery. Solo ownerless disaster on the road; the layer is removed online.

data.title: Raid loop sheet
data.summaryZh: 孵化所 → 五格 → 突入 → 搜打转化 → 撤离 → 定居点。配齐却从未出征不增长帝国。一块做完：真实撤离且账册变化。
data.summaryEn: Hatchery → five slots → extract → search, fight, convert → leave → settlement. A perfect five-slot that never extracts does not grow the empire. A block is done when an extract returns and the ledger moves.

data.title: Sovereign melee rules
data.summaryZh: 第一人称。爪、咬、扑、瘟疫经己眼发生。不持常规步枪。步枪留在人类侧。可啃咬模块化拼装一把特殊枪。
data.summaryEn: First person. Claw, bite, pounce, and plague through your own eyes. No standard rifle. Rifles stay with humans. A special gun may be bite-assembled from modular parts.

data.title: Three-force table
data.summaryZh: 帝国：有组织、可升级。野生：无主灾变，也会咬你。人类：营地哨所要塞，是要夺的地。
data.summaryEn: Empire: organised, obedient, upgradeable. Wild: ownerless disaster that also bites you. Humans: camps, outposts, forts — the ground you take.

data.title: 1v1v1 seat map
data.summaryZh: 帝国潮对帝国潮，五格对五格，野生层移除。人类席为第三人，强到单帝国无法独破。先共围，再分赃或互噬。
data.summaryEn: Empire tide maps to empire tide, five slots to five slots, wild layer removed. Human seat is the third power; one empire cannot crack it alone. Share the siege, then split or eat the other empire.

data.title: Over-summon penalty table
data.summaryZh: 无硬顶。额度为 1000 而召 1100 时，多出的 100 折半，并给人类席派入 50 名枪兵。
data.summaryEn: No hard stop at the printed cap. Call 1,100 against a 1,000 allowance and the extra 100 is halved; fifty human gunners enter for the human faction.

data.title: Failed research sink
data.summaryZh: 失败孵化不退材料。靠夺地补库存；单机也可猎野生。
data.summaryEn: Failed hatchery work does not return materials. Rebuild stock by taking ground, or in solo by hunting the wild.

data.title: Settlement reward sheet
data.summaryZh: 套件、据点株系或研究权。下次出征仍只有五格。基地套件只加厚本战入格的株系。
data.summaryEn: Kits, a site strain, or research rights. Still only five slots next raid. Base kits only thicken strains that occupy a slot this raid.

data.title: Infection and occupation sheet
data.summaryZh: 逐个转化生者；技能批量感染；任务奖励更多尸骸。联机不花孵化所库存，每帝国本场固定 3000。
data.summaryEn: Convert the living one by one, batch-infect with a slotted skill, or finish tasks for more dead. Online PvP does not spend hatchery stock; each empire receives a fixed 3,000.

data.title: Story mode stub
data.summaryZh: 第三模式，仅作记录，尚无完整企划。
data.summaryEn: Third mode. Recorded only. No complete plan yet.

data.title: Reserve ledger executor
data.summaryZh: 按入格协议扣储备；把印刷产量钳在现存头数；阵亡清零下一场。
data.summaryEn: Deducts levy on cast, clamps printed yield to live headcount, and zeroes the next extract after a wipe.

data.title: Loadout assignment runtime
data.summaryZh: 五格绑定、移出、出战门闩。被动不可执行；未入格不可施放。
data.summaryEn: Assign, remove, and gate the five field slots. Passives cannot execute. Unslotted protocols cannot cast.

data.title: Swarm summon executor
data.summaryZh: 按协议 ID 生成玩家尸潮，读取储备钳制与冷却。
data.summaryEn: Spawns the slotted player swarm by protocol id, reading reserve clamp and cooldown.

data.title: Doctrine multiplier executor
data.summaryZh: 把入格被动与孵化所等级写成玩家与尸潮的血、攻、速。
data.summaryEn: Applies slotted passives and Hatchery tier to operator and swarm vitality, offense, and speed.

data.title: Ownerless wild mass
data.summaryZh: 单机道路上的野生尸潮模拟。不受指挥，也会攻击玩家。
data.summaryEn: Solo-road wild mass. No operator. Also attacks the player.

data.title: Claw bite pounce executor
data.summaryZh: 第一人称近战判定与扑击。
data.summaryEn: First-person melee hit and pounce resolve.

data.title: Conversion executor
data.summaryZh: 把生者编入帝国线，并回写入储备增长。
data.summaryEn: Moves the living onto the empire line and writes stock growth.

data.title: Online seat runtime
data.summaryZh: 固定 3000 库存，移除野生层，保留人类席与五格对映。
data.summaryEn: Fixed 3,000 stock per empire, wild layer off, human seat retained, five-slot mapping.

data.title: Over-summon penalty runtime
data.summaryZh: 超额折半，并向人类席注入枪兵。
data.summaryEn: Halves the overflow and injects gunners into the human seat.

data.title: Operator corpse mesh
data.summaryZh: 玩家僵尸模型。资源：Zombie_Woman。
data.summaryEn: Player zombie body. Asset: Zombie_Woman.

data.title: Standard swarm bodies
data.summaryZh: 标准僵尸三维。资源：ZombieMegaBundle、ZombieAnimationPack。
data.summaryEn: Standard zombie 3D pool. Assets: ZombieMegaBundle, ZombieAnimationPack.

data.title: ASCTeuthisan strain mesh
data.summaryZh: 图1选中协议（Lesser Horde）指定僵尸资产。文件夹：ASCTeuthisan。
data.summaryEn: Designated zombie asset for the protocol selected in the vault shot (Lesser Horde). Folder: ASCTeuthisan.

data.title: Human faction roster
data.summaryZh: 人类三维：Droid、Military_robot、SciFi_Drone_1、SciFiOutpost、Mech_01、Grunt_Soldier。
data.summaryEn: Human 3D set: Droid, Military_robot, SciFi_Drone_1, SciFiOutpost, Mech_01, Grunt_Soldier.

data.title: Hatchery facility map
data.summaryZh: 孵化所三维空间。资源：Facility。
data.summaryEn: Hatchery 3D space. Asset: Facility.

data.title: ARMOURY modular guns
data.summaryZh: 人类步枪池，以及玩家啃咬拼装的特殊枪。资源：ARMOURY。
data.summaryEn: Human rifle pool and the bite-assembled special gun. Asset: ARMOURY.

data.title: Blood pool and splatter
data.summaryZh: 动态淤积与溅射。资源：RealisticBlood。其它特效：Explosions_W3Vol1、M5VFXVOL2、MegaMagicVFXBundle、SlashTrail_SoftTofu、Vefects。
data.summaryEn: Dynamic pooling and splatter. Asset: RealisticBlood. Companion FX: Explosions_W3Vol1, M5VFXVOL2, MegaMagicVFXBundle, SlashTrail_SoftTofu, Vefects.

data.summaryZh: 玩家与尸潮的跳、翻墙、爬墙，随孵化所等级解锁。
data.summaryEn: Operator and swarm leap, vault, and climb unlocked by Hatchery tier.

data.summaryEn: First-person and body montages for claw, bite, and pounce.
